main.headline: Give every franchise partner one source of truth
main.deck: One content layer underneath every system your teams use, so partners see only their own content.

paragraphs: **The challenge:** As the franchise network grows, the content partners need sits in four systems — SharePoint, the marketing portal, Airtable and Dropbox. Guidelines are copied between them by hand and shared one link at a time. Every copy is another version to keep current, and another chance a partner sees content meant for someone else.

**The solution:** Box sits underneath the tools your departments already use. Files live in Box once and surface in SharePoint, Teams or the partner portal, so replacing the spring/summer guidelines in one folder updates every place they appear. Access is set per partner on the folder, not on a link, and every open is logged.

main.heading: Three shifts that change how the portal runs.

main.heading: Start with one brand and one season.
paragraphs: Most teams begin with one brand's guidelines for a single season, move those partners across, then bring the next department's content over. Nothing is rebuilt as the network grows.
